ios.desc:
Hunch is a simple markdown editor that helps you discover new connections.

Key Features:
. private by design: all your notes and note embeddings are generated and stored locally on your device, your thoughts remain completely private.
. connected thinking: use simple [[note links]] syntax to create a web of interconnected ideas across your notes.
. form intuition: tracking how your are your are responding to your notes over time, and what holds your attention
